name: Where the Woods Blush
source:
You were invited by an acquaintance to celebrate the spooky season at their Halloween party. But just as you were approaching, your werewolf curse takes over and you flake the event. You hope to wait your transformation out in solitude. 

But someone in the shadows has other plans, tracking you down with haste. Only then will you decide who is the hunter and who is the hunted.

[From [url=https://bukothepanda.itch.io/where-the-woods-blush]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位熟人邀请你参加他们的万圣节派对，庆祝这个恐怖的季节。但就在你接近时，你的狼人诅咒开始起作用，你破坏了事件。你希望在孤独中等待你的转变。

但阴影中的某个人另有计划，正在匆忙追踪你。只有这样你才能决定谁是猎人，谁是猎物。

[来自[url=https://bukothepanda.itch.io/where-the-woods-blush]itch.io[/url]]
